item.title: Daybreak — Aug 24
item.itunes:title: Daybreak — Aug 24
item.description: Global risk premia spike: Bessent's economic D-Day on Iran, US-Canada 50% tariffs, and Ukraine's 300,000-troop mobilization warning converge with French OAT-Bund at 0.85. Top stories: US-Canada Trade War: 50% Tariffs on $20B Take Effect, Carney Retaliates 'Dollar-for-Dollar'; French 10Y at 4.10%, OAT-Bund Spread 0.85 as €126bn Consolidation Hole Erodes Tax-Hike Pledge; Zelensky Rejects Wartime Elections, Warns Russia Will Draft 300,000; Patriot Deliveries Halved. Trades: Long crude and tankers on Hormuz risk, long European defense, short OATs vs Bunds, long gold above $4,636, short CAD/import-dependent EM on tariff shock.

item.description: The long end is repricing US fiscal credibility while the Treasury buys back bonds into a selloff—gold and crypto catch the debasement bid, and every risk asset now trades off 30Y auction demand. Top stories: Walmart US Comparable Sales Hit Six-Year Low; Stock Tumbles 9% Despite Earnings Beat; Nvidia Earnings and Jackson Hole to Test US Rally as Nasdaq Seeks Snap of Losing Streak; US Corporate AI Debt Surge Tests Investor Limits as Fatigue Emerges. Trades: Long gold above $4,600 and Bitcoin above $79,000 on debasement; short US long-end into refunding; overweight European defense and Korean memory; long Egyptian EGX30 and non-US AI beneficiaries; underweight US consumer discretionary.
